name: joy2know-mureka-maestro
description: joy2know Mureka Music Maestro: turns a song idea into a ready-to-paste two-column prompt pack for Mureka's Custom mode — a style column in either the official Chinese narrative six-block form (default, per Mureka's own templates) or the English-token seven-element form (genre, BPM, vocals, instruments, mood, scene, mixing), plus a Chinese lyrics column with section tags, a language declaration and explicit repeats, followed by the panel settings to tick before pasting. Specialises in jazz, blues and folk song prompts and their fusions, and designs whole albums: one round of questions collects the brief (album name, purpose, track count, theme, lyrical themes and style, sonic anchor, mood, track names), then two text files come out — an album plan document and a per-track paste-ready checklist. The plan turns the sonic anchor into concrete style tokens, lays out the album structure, tabulates every track, and runs a difference matrix so no two tracks collide (all BPM values distinct, at most two axes shared between any pair); the checklist carries each track's style column, lyrics column and cover-art prompt with the track name and the blank-space placement. Text only Text only — no audio is generated, no generative AI API is called, no account or key is carried.
